text: {"lessons":["My account rose while I made no trades, but five months of gains do not prove that holding will always outperform or that I can predict what comes next.","Since price changes are random, I should not treat recent gains as a signal to buy, sell, or expect the trend to continue.","Because losses weigh on me more than equal gains please me, I should make calm, planned decisions rather than react emotionally to short-term account changes."]}
